notes: Two gendered titles modernised: POLICEMAN to 'police officer' and SPORTSMAN to 'athlete',
which is what is said now and does not exclude half the people doing the job.
'actor' and 'actress' are kept as a pair: that one is still live in English.
'doctor' and 'nurse' also appear in Health and Illness. Different areas.
EASY: talking about work is more abstract than naming objects.
